pages.title: Motion
pages.html:
Motion

Two durations and two easings, from the motion tokens only. Under reduced motion every duration is 0ms.

Every duration becomes 0ms, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

Durations and easings

Press Replay to move each box with that pair.

  • fast + ease-out
  • fast + ease-in
  • base + ease-out
  • base + ease-in

Rules

  • Entering takes base with ease-out; leaving takes fast with ease-in, so exits are quicker.
  • Floating layers fade and rise 6px from the side they open toward; a dialog pops from 0.96; a sheet slides from its edge.
  • Controls answer at once: colour on fast; nothing shrinks on press.
  • Nothing moves on its own except a skeleton's calm pulse. Rows, links and lists change colour only.
  • Under reduced motion every duration is 0ms and the pulse holds still.
  • Durations and easings come from the motion tokens only; a policy test rejects literals.

Tokens

  • fast
  • base
  • ease-out
  • ease-in
  • scale
  • rise
  • pulse

pages.title: Elevation
pages.html:
Elevation

Surface levels on one elevation scale, from the page to a modal.

Five surface levels on one elevation scale. Each level pairs a fill, a hairline edge and a shadow: dark themes show shadows weakly, so the edge carries the level there.

paperThe page. elevation-0
sheetA card or panel. elevation-1
raisedA surface while hovered or dragged. elevation-2
overlayPopover, menu, Select, tooltip. elevation-2
modalDialog and sheet. elevation-3

Which part sits where

  • Card: sheet.
  • Popover, Dropdown, Select, Command in a popover, Tooltip: overlay.
  • Dialog and Sheet: modal.

One shadow token per level, so a change to elevation-2 changes every floating layer at once.

pages.title: Floating actions and window
pages.html:
Floating actions and window

FloatingDock places a page’s floating actions at the bottom end and the one window an action opens above them. FloatingActions is the capsule; FloatingAction an action with its count and attention dot, pressed while its window is open. FloatingWindow sizes to its content up to the space above the actions.

1 / 2

“Corners are small: 2px on controls, 4px on surfaces.”

sample-lead Agree on 2/4. Counts keep the same radius.

Usage

import { FloatingDock, FloatingActions, FloatingAction, FloatingWindow, FloatingWindowAction } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<FloatingDock top={headerHeight}>
  {open && (
    <FloatingWindow key={open} open label="Discussion" onClose={close} header={<>…<FloatingWindowAction label="Resolve" icon={<Check />} /></>}>
      …
    </FloatingWindow>
  )}
  <FloatingActions label="Page actions">
    <FloatingAction label="Comments (2)" icon={<MessagesSquare />} count={2} expanded={open === 'comments'} onClick={toggle} />
  </FloatingActions>
</FloatingDock>

Variants and states

Closed

Keyboard contract

  • Opening moves focus into the window; Esc or Close closes it through one onClose.
  • Focus returns to the action that opened it. Key the window by that action.
  • An open menu, select or tooltip inside takes the first Esc; only the next one closes the window.
  • A composing (IME), repeated or modified Esc never closes it.
  • One window at a time; its action reads as pressed (aria-expanded) while open.

pages.title: Rich input
pages.html:
Rich input

One Lexical editor in two shapes: the single-line search with filter chips and the multi-line composer with mentions, a toolbar and an attachment slot. It ships in its own entry, so pages without it never load Lexical.

Usage

import { RichInput, emptyRichInputValue } from '@tmt/browser-ui/rich-input';

<RichInput shape="multi" label="Message" value={value} onChange={setValue} onSubmit={send}
  suggestions={[{ kind: 'mention', trigger: '@', options: (query) => … }]} />

Variants and states

Composer

Optional search props

PropBehavior
onSuggestionChooseReturn true to handle a suggestion as an action instead of inserting a chip; receives the edited value without the query.
onChipRemoveReceives the resulting value when a chip is removed.
onEscapeHandles Escape when no suggestion list is open.

Keyboard contract

  • Enter submits; Shift+Enter adds a line in the composer.
  • A trigger opens suggestions: arrows move, Enter or Tab inserts the chip.
  • Esc closes the suggestion list and stops there, so a window around stays open.
  • Backspace after a chip removes it; nothing acts during an IME composition. Optional onChipRemove reports the edited value to its host.
  • Optional onSuggestionChoose can handle a suggestion as an action instead of inserting a chip; onEscape handles Escape when no list is open.
  • Paste is plain text; on the single line a pasted break becomes a space.

  • The row never jumps when its state changes.
  • Failure is the blocked mark and a word, never red text alone.

Loading and error states

Loading keeps the layout with skeleton rows; an error says what failed, keeps what was on screen and offers one way on.
